notes: UNSUPPORTED: 'city'. The Junon grassland set has no city buildings, walls, gates or ruins, and no lifted prefab is bigger than a hamlet. Closest possible: three village clusters scattered over the map.
UNSUPPORTED: 'abandoned' as broken or ruined buildings: every Junon building model is intact. Expressed instead as no roads between the clusters and overgrown ground around and between them.
Jagged terrain: the 'rugged' character (short, high hills; play slopes up to 45 degrees).
A real abandoned city needs another tileset's buildings and ruins: see PLAN.md, Beyond v1.

Phase 7b: the Adventurer's Plain and Kenji Beach clusters stand on stilts over water in retail; inland they are their dry-ground variants (adventurer_houses, kenji_houses_land: same houses and crates, no decks).
Phase 7b: low cliffs (25 m) with a boulder rim around an organic play area (the defaults).
name: Mapgen Ruins
